text:
`python3 -m unittest` now reports all 16 tests passing. I only changed code in `catalog/`, and the tests are untouched.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an int.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days instead of multiplying. It now multiplies.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5. The comment above it already said five.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. I also made `recent(0)` return an empty list, which no test covers. Without that, `[-0:]` would have returned the whole history.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing `Emma`, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count are my guess, since the tests only check the title.
